author: Dr. F
text_post: G'day folks, I am delighted to say that the new forum is up. Quote Miner's Graveyard. That's right. The forum that the quote miners dread to see is now up for your perusal. Go check it out. Leave comments and throw rotten tomatoes at the fools there. The MRM does not want these idiots and your voice in those threads will let them know all the more that we disdain violence to anyone in all it's repulsive forms.  The feminist quote miners who visit there will grit their teeth while they read how the MRM as a humanitarian movement proves once again that we are the exact opposite of them. The kitchen is closed for them and sadly, they look through the window just wanting to get their grubby hands on the plants they have sent over here. Next stop I am afraid is the tossing of them under their pink bus. "Fools", they cry, "You were supposed to talk violence on that forum and remain there."
